textbook.note: The two-step logic (saturated cohort-by-period TWFE, then margins averaging fitted minus counterfactual predictions) is Wooldridge's (2021, 2025) extended TWFE and imputation reading. Keep a few sentences of what wooldid does, drop the tutorial register ('Broadly speaking', 'To flesh this out').
Notation glossary for the Step 1 regression (i, t, j, Z, Tz_it, TreatedFlag_it). A Wooldridge reader knows it. One sentence defining Z and TreatedFlag_it suffices.
ATT as the weighted average of fitted minus counterfactual fitted values over treated observations, and other estimands by reweighting. This is the standard imputation reading of the ETWFE estimator.
Delta-method SEs from margins taken conditional on covariates versus margins' vce(unconditional). Textbook, and [151] repeats it. The e(df_r) sentences are corrections, keep them once at [426].
Conditional versus unconditional SEs (covariates fixed versus sampled). Wooldridge (2025) discusses this directly.

When conditional and unconditional SEs differ, sample versus population average. Wooldridge (2025) material. The four middle sentences were added as a correction: compress, but keep 'unconditional is larger under heterogeneity and the gap does not shrink with n' and 'conditional describes the sample treated average'.

The virtue and cost of Ibragimov and Muller (2010), better with few heterogeneous clusters and needing independent cluster estimates. Textbook. Keep the wooldid-specific sentence that a cluster's estimate uses its treated post-treatment cells alone.
Opening sentence: what a DiD estimate compares, treated periods against a pre-treatment reference. Textbook.
